title: Classify the quadratic query before claiming blur invariance
statement: For f(x,y)=(y-x)^T S(x)(y-x), separate harmonicity requires trace S=div S=Delta S=0. In two dimensions the corresponding complex field is holomorphic. Independent radial averaging then preserves the stated query only on its support/harmonic domain; an unrestricted Gaussian tail or square pixel does not automatically satisfy the exact contract.

requires: Actual paired images, fixed matched-pair covariance law, finite brightness second moments and L2 weighted sums
Specified quadratic harmonic kernel; support disks avoid its pole, with warranted aperture/tails and pixel/roundoff allowances
Positive admitted normalizer plus separately supplied lag/scale/calibration/statistical/mechanical contract before physical normalization
provides: A conditional blur-compatible quadratic query with exact field-specific support
assumptions: Generic radial-blur invariance is established prior, not a new blanket theorem
Endpoint and start pole-avoidance requirements differ for forward versus difference/self controls
No normalized physical output follows from invariance alone
costs: Eight weighted sums plus one total on each executed frame, storage, raw retrieval and all failed/partial acquisitions
Producer processed 500 experimental images; the reviewer checked all 250 pair labels and four TIFF headers plus exact saved normalizers, without rerunning pixels
Fixed-point rounding, finite source record, lag/acceleration, optical tails and volume/mechanical coverage remain paid
contract.units: Native image-coordinate weighted covariances and finite-lag currents; physical torque additionally needs calibrated scale/lag, volume, fluid parameters, walls and force/unsteadiness corrections. n independent record draws is not pixels or particles.
contract.obstruction: Unknown blur cannot be removed from an arbitrary desired mechanical functional.

evidence.quote: ## 2. Classification of the blur-compatible quadratic query
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: Fixed matched-pair Poisson law, finite brightness second moments/L2 image sums, linear imaging, suitable independent radial PSFs, full capture/tail/pixel bounds and mechanics are substantive conditions. A common-flow/Cox mixture need not satisfy the variance law. The native rectangular time series is not an annular torque experiment, IID reset data or a per-file calibrated lag. Negative empirical normalization is not population impossibility. No sign flip, alternate pairing or replacement denominator is inferred. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Acquired completed substantive independent whole corrected mathematics/code/finite-record review. Eleven available non-third-party subjects match its explicit source pins and the corrected later manifest. One external database text and original images remain outside this public selection. No new pixel/experiment replay or physical torque measurement.
